verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents no dedicated sandbox or test environment. The closest evidence is that the tax estimate endpoint is idempotent and creates no permanent transaction records, which the docs call "perfect for testing tax calculations." Separately, the MCP server only reads public docs and never proxies API calls, so AI-assisted development there cannot touch live data. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment or test-mode API keys, safe testing for transaction sync/filings/registrations (which create permanent records), test data seeding or reset, and independent corroboration.
